summary: All 5 review items PASSED end-to-end. Backend pytest 15/15 in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_stock_features.py (admin_stock_results.xml): (A) Stock adjust +3/-1 correct counts; DELETE /stock/unit removes a unit; staff gets 403 on both /stock/adjust and DELETE /stock/unit. Auth restored (abdul=Salam@123). Only pre-existing benign warning is the deprecated `props.pointerEvents` from batch-buy overlay (carried over from iteration_10/11).
